changes: Quick updates are now truly quiet — no more questions: your saved answers are reused (Discord, wallpapers, videos) once you've answered them once
- Picker validation messages (Invalid/Cancelled) now go to stderr, keeping command-substitution output pure
- update wallpaper add / update pfp add (also --add, -add) install the other pack alongside — without the flag the chosen pack replaces the other (folder + XML)

- A tiny system-wide rescue detector now guards 'update': if ~/.config/fish/functions/update.fish is ever deleted, the /etc copy detects it, explains the missing dependencies and offers to download the latest update function (yes is the default, 5 tries, fingerprint-verified) — the updater never runs until the user copy is restored
All setup prompts moved from bootstrap into the installer — bootstrap is just the start button now: splash, verify, download, hand off
Discord's answer is now saved too (it was the only prompt without persistence)
Bootstrap no longer prints its own system-info box — the dashboard shows once, from the installer
Bootstrap no longer prints its own SECURE TUNNEL box — the tunnel shows once, from the installer
Tunnel location is hidden — a generic 'Location: Secure' row instead of fake CDN node details
The installer download now shows a live progress bar — the clone runs quietly in the background, no more raw git text
The download progress bar now matches the updater's loader — braille spinner, rotating status, [███░░░] bar with real percent (re-pinned bootstrap fingerprint)
Fixed the download progress bar crashing on the first tick (grep no-match tripped the ERR trap under set -euo pipefail); percent now only moves forward
Fish config backups keep the same 5-snapshot limit as dconf (was 10) — 6th and older auto-deleted on every config apply
The start screen waits 60 seconds max — no key press and bootstrap closes itself (just run it again when you're ready)
Closing bootstrap early (Ctrl+C forced exit or the 60s auto-close) leaves no log behind — the temp log is deleted, since nothing ran
Running install.sh directly now behaves the same: every wait and yes/no question auto-closes after 60s of silence, and closing it early (Ctrl+C twice or the timeout) deletes the log too
A closed installer is no longer reported as a failure — the updater says 'closed before finishing' and you just run it again when ready
Fixed the crooked log-header box (blank rows and data rows now line up with the 62-wide border) and the 'More from Eprahemi' box (links no longer poke past the right edge)
The kitty one-liner no longer bursts out of its box — it's now shown as a clean code line under both warning boxes (bootstrap + installer)
Deep-scan cleanup: removed dead code (unused _save_prompt_answers_all, stray _rc captures, unused PINK color in bootstrap) and re-pinned the bootstrap fingerprint
Fixed kitty terminal boxes: ✦/⚠ title rows padded correctly for narrow glyphs; removed leftover over-padding on the "Press any key" rows
The update menu no longer lists every step that will re-run — just what's new, then the choice. Cleaner.
Fixed the progress bar showing '�' blocks — the bar builder used tr (byte-based, mangles multi-byte █); now built with string concat like install.sh's sed bars, byte-perfect in any locale

MacTahoe GTK source is now vendored in the repo (vendor/MacTahoe-gtk-theme) — if the upstream repo is ever deleted or unreachable, the theme still compiles fresh for your GNOME version, and GDM + Firefox theming still work via the vendored tweaks.sh

The firewalld question moved up front — it now appears with the Discord/wallpaper/video prompts before Phase 1, so the installation never pauses mid-flow; the actual disable (or keep/enable) still happens in the 'Disable RAM-wasting Services' step, and your answer is saved like the others

update menu — per-target toolbox: re-run a single part of the setup with update <target> (icons, gtk, extensions, wallpaper, pfp, theme, fonts, sounds, videos, services, gdm, defaults, dconf, notifier, clean) — no full reinstall needed

update <target> asks about logging out when the change needs a fresh session — per-target reason in the box (theme/gtk/extensions/gdm/wallpaper/icons/fonts), strict y/n with no default so Enter alone never logs you out
Every update fetch now shows a live braille spinner while cloning — same style as the installer's loader, no more static 'Fetching...' text
Ctrl+C is now safe everywhere: cancelling mid-install or mid-fetch prints '✘ Cancelled — nothing was changed.', never touches your setup, and cleans up the temp files
Fixed the download spinner never noticing a failed clone (fish's wait always reported success) — git's real exit code is read from the temp bundle now, so connection errors are reported honestly

Self-healing 'update' command — if update.fish is ever deleted (say, a wiped fish config), the boot + 2-hour updater timer restores it automatically, fingerprint-verified against the pinned sha256 so unverified code is never installed
System-wide rescue copy — the installer keeps a root-owned copy of update.fish outside your home folder: even with the entire fish config wiped, the 'update' command still answers

update configs now refreshes every config location — kitty, fish (config + all 40 functions), starship, GTK, fastfetch, systemd units AND the update notifier (script + timer): every folder is created if missing, every file overwrites if present, and your fish config is auto-backed up before any override
update configs also keeps the system-wide rescue copy current — done silently, without asking for a password or printing anything extra
update configs no longer leaks ktheme's raw error if the wallpaper file ever goes missing — the live re-theme is fully silent now
update configs confirms with '✓ Rescue copy (system-wide) updated.' only when the system-wide copy was actually refreshed (warm sudo window); with no cached credentials it stays silent and skips
Security hardening pass — the full audit is in:
Verified update chain — installs are fingerprint-checked, tamper-proof downloads, a trust prompt the first time, hard refusal on any mismatch
Your settings are safe — a full dconf snapshot is saved before anything touches your GNOME settings (restore with one command)
gdm wallpaper switching no longer uses shared /tmp — everything stays in your private cache
Kitty control sockets are private now — no other user can connect to your terminal
Automatic security downloads — patches download in the background nightly (never installed without your say-so)
Backup snapshots are private too — folder and files locked to you only
Fish config safety net — every config refresh auto-backups your live fish folder first (last 10 snapshots kept)
The can't-lose-it guard — a root-owned warning in the system fish config: if your fish config is ever deleted, every terminal shows the exact one-line recovery

Kitty follows your wallpaper — ktheme pulls the colors out of your desktop picture and re-themes every kitty window, live. A quiet background watcher does it automatically every time the wallpaper changes (ktheme on/off to control it)
Kitty Colorful Edition — a fresh full palette, interactive kittens (ctrl+shift+f4 themes, ctrl+shift+d diff) and remote control from any terminal
hint — a little teacher in your terminal: shortcuts, functions, the palette, and live demos, all in one menu
fastfetch shows your terminal; old kitty/fastfetch config backups cleaned up
New Fish function: smb — full Samba file sharing manager (setup, users, shares, passwords, data export, service control)
Updated 18+ wallpaper pack with new backgrounds
Window Title Pro Topbar v8 — separator dropdown, font size control, smart row sensitivity, readable shortcuts (Super+Y)
New Fish functions: kit (Kitty theme toggle), ghlogin (GitHub auth + git config with auto-fetch), pfp (profile picture with cropped preview)
install.sh: 28 proper steps — Celluloid default player + Nautilus per-folder defaults now tracked steps
Kitty close warning enabled (confirm_os_window_close 1)
Window Title Pro now installs from GNOME Extensions (EGO) instead of GitHub releases — extension #10319 approved and active
Window Title Pro updated to v4 — fixed-width default now off (set <default>false</default> in gschema)
Window Title Pro updated to v3 — EGO review fixes (destroy(), no try-catch, no gschemas.compiled, no donations)
WTP v2 URL fix: asset is window-title-pro-v2.zip (not window-title-pro.zip)
Window Title Pro v2 — show-title now defaults to off (set <default>false</default> in gschema)
update.fish ANSI escape fix: replaced echo with printf (Fish echo ignores \033)
update.fish read prompt fix: plain text in -P instead of \e codes
Update check timer: OnBootSec reduced from 5min to 2min
Fix 'Update Now' not opening Kitty: replaced nohup+inline with temp launcher script

Incremental update: update.fish + 'Update Now' use UPDATE_MODE=incremental
Version-only updater: notification fires on version bumps, not every commit
install-state.json: per-step versions + overall install version, atomic writes
GTK theme compiles for GNOME 47/48, per-step caching
SF Pro fonts, Big Sur sounds, GDM theme, Firefox userChrome
